sourceTitle: Noodles With Broccoli Chicken In Cheese Sauce
sourceText:
Noodles With Broccoli Chicken In Cheese Sauce
By: Lamay Schlichti...
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:19am

Ingredients




5 tablespoons butter or margarine
 cup all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon of salt
1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
2 1/2 cups of milk
2 cups (8 oz.) shredded cheddar cheese
1 1/2 cups fresh or frozen broccoli flowerets
2 mediums chicken breast cut as desired and cook over medium heat w/olive oil
1/2 package Extra wide egg noodles

Preparation

1 In a large saucepan over medium heat, melt butter; stir in flour,salt and pepper. Cook 1 minute. Add Milk; cook, stirring frequently until slightly thickened. Stir in cheese, broccoli and chicken until cheese melts. Cook noodles according to package directions. Toss hot noodles with sauce.
